Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service

Class LegalTrendDetectionService

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.domain.service.LegalTrendDetectionService
All Implemented Interfaces:
DetectLegalTrendsUseCase
public class LegalTrendDetectionService extends Object implements DetectLegalTrendsUseCase
Domain service implementing the legal trend detection use case.

Orchestrates LLM-based topic extraction specifically for legal, regulatory, and policy articles. The pipeline mirrors TrendOrchestrationService but is scoped to legal-domain data:

  1. Fetch recent (30-day) and prior (31-90 day) legal + policy articles
  2. Include regulatory event titles as additional inputs for theme extraction
  3. Call LLM topic extraction on both windows
  4. Compute momentum and classify signals as RISING, NEW, or STABLE
  5. Tag each signal with a category (LITIGATION, REGULATION, POLICY)
  6. Optionally generate summaries for top signals
  7. Persist snapshot via LegalTrendSnapshotPort

This class carries no Spring annotations — it is wired as a @Bean in AppConfig.
